scope: Five assigned missing EveryNoise labels; existing source rows preserved.
model_policy: Research grounds label scope, repertoire, cultural anchors and documented performance descriptions. Every explicit room, chain stage, tuning, numeric effect setting, sampler resolution/swing or instrument variant is an authored recording model unless a source note says otherwise. None of these recipes is presented as measured audio or an exact historical session reconstruction. The 808 instrument card represents 808-derived programmed rhythm, and the selected modern recreation does not imply use of a 1980s hardware unit.

sources.title: Aesop Rock — Official Artist Page | Rhymesayers
sources.support: Explicitly identifies dense and abstract wordplay and his Def Jux affiliation; supports the writing-led description.

sources.title: Aesop Rock Labor Days 20 Year Anniversary
sources.type: label publication with artist first-person account
sources.support: Dates the album to 2001, names collaborators, and includes Aesop’s account of recording on a Roland VS-880, the Manhattan day job and Blockhead’s sample ear.

sources.title: Interview with Blockhead — R4NT, May 1, 2004
sources.support: Blockhead explains finding samples by playing records and making music with a sampler and Pro Tools; NYC influence supports the New York anchor. Interview concerns his practice in 2004, not exact Labor Days session specifications.

entries.model_choice: A sample-based solo-MC strand of a wider writing-led genre: rhythmic speech with narrative articulation and a single lead, sixteen-bit chopped beat/sample cards with moderate swing. Ensoniq-model sampler is an authored catalog proxy, not an attested Labor Days instrument.

nearby_distinctions.conscious_hip_hop: Defined by socially or politically engaged topics, not necessarily associative abstract writing.
nearby_distinctions.alternative_hip_hop: A broader category; abstract MC writing selects a narrower emphasis.
nearby_distinctions.instrumental_hip_hop: Does not require a foreground MC, unlike this selected model.

entries.geo_rationale: Manhattan anchors the selected Labor Days collaborators and Aesop’s first-person account of its creation; not an exclusive birthplace claim for abstract hip-hop.

sources.type: institutional recording essay containing producer testimony
sources.support: Documents Long Island / Amityville formation, Prince Paul’s demo overdubs and Calliope sessions, layered sample construction and skits; producer quotations support the selected collage strand.

sources.title: De La Soul — official website
sources.support: Lists 3 Feet High & Rising and De La Soul Is Dead; anchors the named repertoire, not every sonic claim.

entries.model_choice: Historical sample-collage strand with response-lane vocal exchanges, layered twelve-bit sample playback, swung breaks and ornamental turntable gestures. The SP-1200 proxy, bit depth and swing setting are authored. A period-compatible tape/inline-console chain is a model, not a claim about Calliope’s exact desk or tape speed.

nearby_distinctions.conscious_hip_hop: A topical orientation, whereas alternative covers formal and musical departures.
nearby_distinctions.abstract_hip_hop: Writing-led narrower emphasis, not coextensive with the alternative umbrella.
nearby_distinctions.boom_bap: A narrower rhythmic production designation; alternative can encompass live bands and electronic forms.

entries.geo_rationale: Amityville represents the documented formative cultural circle; the essay places actual demo sessions at Calliope in New York. Coordinates identify the town approximately, not a studio address.

sources.title: Lazy Sunday — The Lonely Island
sources.support: Identifies Andy and Chris Parnell rapping a comic Sunday narrative; dates the SNL Digital Short December 17, 2005 and connects it to Incredibad.

sources.title: Incredibad — The Lonely Island
sources.support: Dates the album February 10, 2009 and lists rap tracks and collaborators. The page also demonstrates a mixed-style album; model selects its rap repertoire, not every song on it.

sources.title: The Tour at NBC Studios — official NBC site
sources.support: Names Saturday Night Live among the shows made at NBC Studios and places the studios at 30 Rockefeller Plaza, Manhattan; supports the selected New York television/recording-context anchor, not the exact room where Lazy Sunday vocals were tracked.

entries.model_choice: A contemporary comedy-song studio model selecting rapid comic diction, response phrases, doubled delivery, straight-grid layered drum one-shots and pitched sampler stabs. No claim that every comedy rapper uses this arrangement, MPC model or sample resolution.

nearby_distinctions.alternative_hip_hop: Defined broadly by musical departure, while comedy rap is organized by comic purpose.
nearby_distinctions.stand_up_comedy: Spoken stage monologue need not retain rap meter, beat or song form.
nearby_distinctions.hip_hop: The wider tradition includes serious and comic purposes; occasional jokes are insufficient to define comedy rap.

entries.geo_rationale: New York / SNL anchors the selected Lazy Sunday television setting, confirmed by the artist video page and NBC’s Manhattan location page. It is a recording-context point, not a claim about the exact vocal tracking room or birthplace of comedy rap.

sources.support: Provides the 2014 project and credits Dark Light to Night Lovell’s production. Used as an artist recording anchor; fan comments on the page are not evidence.

sources.title: Episode 119: Night Lovell — Kinda Neat, November 2, 2016
sources.support: Introduces the Ottawa artist as baritone-voiced and hosts his Contraband performance; supports low vocal character and the Ottawa anchor.

sources.title: Concept Vague — Night Lovell original SoundCloud album playlist
sources.support: Original December 2014 artist playlist links directly to the selected Bandcamp album, corroborating its provenance. No location is inferred from the cryptic Bandcamp profile coordinates.

entries.model_choice: A restrained ominous digital trap strand with a single low speech-derived lead, a sustained synth pad and 808-derived bass pulse. Triangle oscillator, saturating filter, minimal vocal effort, hall reverb and modern digital 808 recreation are authored creative approximations; they are not measured features of Concept Vague.

nearby_distinctions.cloud_rap: Broader atmospheric rap; this model privileges ominous baritone and weighty bass rather than weightless wash.
nearby_distinctions.memphis_rap: The existing historical cassette-economy lineage, not this 2010s digital model.
nearby_distinctions.rage_rap: Selects aggressive lead-synth and high-energy presentation; the dark model uses restrained vocal/pad space.

entries.geo_rationale: Ottawa is explicitly documented by the performer interview and represents this selected recording lineage. Dark trap is internet-distributed and has no exclusive Ottawa origin claim.

sources.type: label release announcement with artist testimony
sources.support: Provides the mixtape release date and artist’s faith-and-hope message; frames the music for both club and church.

sources.title: Artist 1K Phew — Reach Records official videos
sources.support: Lists Church House Trap House among official recordings. Confirms repertoire rather than a precise instrument or effect setting.

sources.title: Artist 1K Phew — Reach Records releases
sources.support: Dates What’s Understood 2 October 31, 2019, Never Too Late October 27, 2017 and As I Am October 7, 2022, which includes Church House Trap House.

entries.model_choice: East Atlanta faith-centered trap production with 808-derived bass, short synth notes, punctuated MC delivery and ad-lib responses. Subtle 50–100 ms correction, oscillator/filter/envelope settings, digital delay and the Atlanta archetype are authored settings, not transcriptions of 1K Phew session documentation.

nearby_distinctions.christian_hip_hop: The existing broad thematic genre spans multiple beat traditions; Christian trap narrows to the trap-production strand.
nearby_distinctions.trap: The broad production umbrella is not restricted to faith/hope testimony.
nearby_distinctions.pentecostal_gospel: A different performance tradition; no choir, organ or congregation is inferred merely from Christian identity.

entries.geo_rationale: East Atlanta is the artist’s explicitly documented formative trap context. Coordinates are an approximate cultural anchor; no source establishes a specific recording-room address.

verification_notes: The temporary verification harness called scripts/_load_app.js to execute the actual browser source and scripts/_seed_workspace.js for connector seeding. It compared all formats and validated every applicable authored part choice on each card.
Actual recipe.js --tradition <id> --json output was checked after optimization. Neighbor labels may be stapled as scoring context; authored primary rosters and all applicable pins survived.
Node child-process spawning was blocked in this runtime (EPERM); shell-invoked CLI commands supplied JSON and recipe text to the verification harness. No test was omitted as a result.
Final integrated signatures and generated artifacts are owned by the root integration pass; this lane did not edit them.
